item.title: City of Greater Geraldton to gear up for rabbit control baiting, warning residents with pets to be wary
item.description: The City of Greater Geraldton is urging residents with pets to be aware of baited locations as it begins its annual integrated rabbit control program.

item.title: Community benefits from renewables in Dandaragan, other Mid West shires wait to see results of pilot program
item.description: Local governments are reacting to new guidelines released by the State Government outlining what benefits communities can receive for playing host to renewable energy infrastructure.

item.title: Mission accomplished: Women Inspiring Better Business celebrate Geraldton women with annual IWD breakfast
item.description: Geraldton’s annual International Women’s Day breakfast run by Women Inspiring Better Business pulled out all the stops on Friday morning to give women from all walks of life a reason to smile and celebrate.

item.title: Opinion with Peter Sweeney: Dennis Cometti was proud of his Geraldton origins and loved a laugh
item.description: Dennis Cometti asked — or nearly demanded — that I achieve one thing when I was editor of The Geraldton Guardian.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Candice Evans: How to avoid being ripped off by paying a lot more for certain services
item.description: How would you feel knowing you paid 10 times more than necessary just because you clicked on the first link in your search results?

item.title: Snapshot in Time: Image of Geraldton foreshore in 1876 one of the oldest in the library’s collection
item.description: This early view of Geraldton is one of the oldest photos in the library collection, and dates back to 1876.

item.title: Geraldton Medicare Urgent Care Clinic has busy first weekend, with 40 patients needing urgent medical care
item.description: Following its grand opening last Thursday, Geraldton’s Urgent Care Clinic was busy during its first weekend.

item.title: Geraldton to get a new permanent helicopter, but MLA Kirrilee Warr questions if it’s for right purpose
item.description: Geraldton may be getting a new helicopter permanently stationed here to respond to power outages, but local MP Kirrilee Warr says it is not enough.

item.title: Local motocross rider Addison Orr crowned Best in the West as she prepares for big career leap
item.description: Geraldton motocross rider Addison Orr has kicked off 2026 in impressive fashion, stepping into the senior ranks for the first time and immediately making her mark at the annual Best in the West event.

item.title: Geraldton softball: Rams dispose of Marlins to lock in place for women’s top division decider
item.description: Rams booked a ticket into the Geraldton Softball Association women’s division one grand final after a 6-4 qualifying final win against Marlins at Utakarra.
